subject: Procurement/commercial path: PO vs Card & Hosted vs Dedicated
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: discovery recap & procurement questions

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so your procurement team has the right context.

Recap:
- Primary use case: real-time personalized content generation for account-based campaigns (low-latency 2nd-truncation inference).
- Expected monthly spend range: $15k–$45k depending on commits and traffic pattern; initial pilot expected ~$10k–$15k/mo.
- Deployment preference: hosted API for first 6–12 months; evaluating Dedicated for production if predictable commits are required.

Procurement/commercial questions we flagged on the call:
1) Paper process: do you require an SOW + Data Processing Addendum prior to purchase?
2) Payment method: PO (Net 30) vs corporate card (one-time card) — which does your vendor onboarding prefer?
3) Marketplace: would you (or Procurement) prefer procurement through your cloud marketplace vendor (AWS Marketplace) to centralize billing?

Attachments: I attached a short "Commercial Path" one-pager that outlines Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private and a template SOW draft for review (Redwood-Commercial-Path-v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx).

Suggested next steps:
- If Procurement prefers PO/Net terms, please share any standard purchase order language or routing steps.
- If card or marketplace is preferred, confirm and we can issue an invoice or provide marketplace listing info.
- Aditya and I can put together a 1-page mutual action plan and timeline for procurement milestones.

Would love to get procurement's preference so we can align pricing/commit options.

Thanks,

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-Commercial-Path-v1.pdf (1 page overview)
Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (editable template)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery recap & procurement questions

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Looping in procurement so they see the attachments.

Procurement notes (high level):
- We prefer PO / Net 30 for any vendor with >$5k/month committed spend. For pilots <$5k/mo we can use a corporate card.
- Marketplace is preferred if the vendor is listed on AWS Marketplace (one-contract, centralized billing), but marketplace onboarding takes ~3–4 weeks.
- We will need a standard DPA (we can share our template) and SOC2 attestation. Can you confirm SOC2 type II status dates?

Question for Redwood: if we start hosted and then move to Dedicated, do you support a smooth model pin + data migration? Also: what are the minimum commit tiers for Dedicated (monthly)?

Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, FinTechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com

Note from Procurement: procurement@fintechco.com — please send SOC2 link and indicate PO/Marketplace steps.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@fintechco.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: discovery recap & procurement questions

Hi Alex / Procurement team —

Thanks — quick answers below and proposed path depending on your procurement preference.

1) Compliance: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (report issued 2026-03-01). Link to the report (redacted) and our DPA template: https://redwood.inference/security/soc2-2026 (we can provide full report under NDA).

2) Hosted -> Dedicated migration: We support a transition path — same API surface, model pinning to ensure deterministic results, and assistance from our Solutions team to migrate workloads and update routing. There is some coordination required for stateful caches and any private VPC connectivity for Dedicated; typical migration 2–6 weeks depending on scale.

3) Dedicated commit tiers: monthly reserved capacity starting at $30k/mo, mid-tier $75k/mo, enterprise tiers available (custom pricing).

Commercial paths based on your procurement preference:
- PO / Net 30 (preferred for >$5k/mo): We can do an SOW + Master Services Agreement and invoice Net 30. Use FD-2026-0457 on the PO.
- Card / Pilot: For the pilot, we can take a corporate card payment and transition to PO when you scale.
- AWS Marketplace: We are on AWS Marketplace (contracting and billing centralized). If you want marketplace invoicing we can expedite listing details but expect an extra 3–4 week lead time.

Next steps I propose:
- If Procurement prefers PO: Procurement shares PO routing and any redlines to our SOW template — we will loop Legal.
- If Card/Pilot: let us know the card contact and we will send an invoice link.
- If Marketplace: confirm and we'll send marketplace purchase instructions + procurement team contact at AWS.

Aditya / Dev — can you please draft the 1-page mutual action plan and a simple pricing summary for the three paths (Hosted on-demand & commits, Dedicated commit tiers, Marketplace billing cadence)?

Thanks,
—Marissa

Attachments: Redwood-Commercial-Path-v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx
